items.title: Zlatni Rat
items.summary: Iconic pebble beach with a unique shape.

body.value: Located in Bol on the island of Brač, Zlatni Rat changes shape depending on wind and currents.

items.title: Banje Beach
items.summary: Popular city beach with views of Dubrovnik Old Town.

body.value: A lively beach close to Dubrovnik’s historic center, perfect for swimming and sunbathing.

items.title: Stiniva Beach
items.summary: Hidden cove surrounded by cliffs on Vis island.

body.value: Stiniva is known for its dramatic entrance and crystal-clear water.

items.title: Sakarun Beach
items.summary: White sand and turquoise water in northern Dalmatia.

body.value: One of the rare sandy beaches in Croatia, ideal for families.
